propositions: Jira-specific probe code (URL construction, basic-auth GET, status-name classification) currently lives in backend-neutral core module inbound_probe.py, violating vendor abstraction.
inbound_probe.py is location-pinned at package root and dynamically loaded by name; moving its entire contents would break the ADR 0035 contract.
No abstraction seam exists for a second backend to drop in an alternative probe implementation without duplicating or modifying neutral core code.

A runtime-checkable SupportsAbsenceProbe capability protocol must enable run_differs.py to dispatch through backend-specific probe implementations, with graceful degradation to UNREACHABLE for non-implementing backends.

Jira probe mechanics (REST URL shape, GET-only invariant, status-name classification, environment variable resolution) must move to adapters/jira/probe.py; neutral vocabulary (ProbeBranch, ProbeResult, ProbeConfigError) must remain in inbound_probe.py.
AST-level neutrality gate must assert zero adapters.jira imports in inbound_probe.py to prevent future vendor coupling.
